description: The module's membership of the shared PBS backup job, and the retention/placement policy that governs it.
_note: update-service.sh re-asserts membership in the shared job and migrates a legacy --all job to the managed model — a set operation over the job's vmid list, plus a schedule/retention apply. That is a reconcile with domain knowledge (see lib/pbs-job.sh, lib/pbs-placement.sh), not a per-field set, so every field is apply:'reconcile'. Backup policy is also a CASCADE (site → environment → module, ADR-007 P9): the effective value is resolved by backup-manager, and a per-field differ here would compare only the module layer and call the rest drift.

backup.description: Module-level backup policy (ADR-007 P9). The leaf of the Site -> Environment -> Module backup cascade: backup-manager resolves the effective policy by merging site.json backup.defaultRetention, the environment's backup.retention/residency, then these module overrides. install-module.sh persists the resolved policy onto the deployed module config. Does NOT replace the dependsOn backup:vm wiring (which decides whether the VM is in the shared PBS job) — it records the resolved retention/exclude/enabled state.

enabled.description: Whether this module is backed up. false disables backup for the module regardless of site/environment policy.

retention.description: Module-specific retention period (e.g. 1y). Overrides the environment/site retention in the cascade. Empty/absent inherits.

exclude.description: Paths to exclude from this module's backup.

backup.note: Authored optionally in the source module JSON; the resolved (cascaded) value is written back into /home/tappaas/config/<name>.json at install time.
backup.changeNote: The module's layer of the retention/exclude/enabled cascade. Changing it changes future backups only; nothing already stored is touched, and no guest is disturbed.

alwaysBackup.description: Set only on the backup module. List of module names whose VMs are always added to the PBS backup job, even though they do not (and cannot) declare dependsOn backup:vm — typically foundation VMs that bootstrap before the backup server (firewall, tappaas-cicd).
alwaysBackup.note: Each entry is a module/VM name resolved to its VMID via /home/tappaas/config/<name>.json. Registered when the backup module installs/updates.
alwaysBackup.changeNote: Set only on the backup module itself: the modules whose VMs are always in the job even though they cannot declare dependsOn backup:vm (the foundation VMs that bootstrap before the backup server).

pbsStorageName.description: Name of the Proxmox Backup Server datastore / Proxmox storage used for backups. Set on the backup module; read by backup:vm scripts (install/test/restore/backup-manage).
pbsStorageName.note: Allows environments whose PBS storage uses a different name (e.g. 'pbs') to override the default. Used as both the PBS datastore name and the Proxmox storage name.
pbsStorageName.changeNote: Which PBS datastore the job writes to.

immutableSnapshots.description: Backup module, optional WORM-ish immutability (ADR-012 §3.5 / ADR-010 §7.3, #389). When enabled, periodic read-only ZFS snapshots of the datastore dataset are taken on the PBS node and pruned to `keep`, so backup history cannot be rewritten by a sync/push credential holder or PBS prune/GC — only by node-local root. The weaker of the two tiers; S3 Object Lock (ADR-010 satellite) is the stronger one and is provisioned satellite-side.

enabled.description: Enable ZFS-snapshot immutability for the local datastore.

schedule.description: systemd OnCalendar value or a friendly word (hourly|daily|weekly).

keep.description: Number of newest immutable snapshots to retain (older pruned).

immutableSnapshots.note: Set only on the backup module. ZFS snapshots protect against credential-holder/prune tampering, not node-root compromise (use S3 Object Lock on a satellite for that).
immutableSnapshots.changeNote: Periodic read-only ZFS snapshots of the datastore so backup history cannot be rewritten (ADR-012 §3.5). Enabling it provisions on the PBS node, not on the consuming guest.

placement.description: Backup module placement policy (ADR-012). Decides WHERE (or whether) a local PBS datastore is realized. 'auto' discovers a tankc pool (preferred node .node first, then any node) and installs PBS there, falling back to a shim if none exists. 'node:<name>' pins PBS to that node's tankc. 'shim' records a datastore-less marker that still satisfies dependsOn:backup and is promotable later via update-module.sh backup. 'remote-only' installs no local PBS (off-site push, ADR-012 P4). The resolved outcome is written back as .placementState (local|shim|remote-only).
placement.note: Set only on the backup module. Replaces the old hard node/storage literals as the source of placement truth; .node/.storage remain the preferred hints for 'auto'.
placement.changeNote: Where the module's backups are allowed to live (auto / a named target).

placementState.description: Resolved backup placement, written by backup/install.sh|update.sh (ADR-012): 'local' (PBS realized on .node/.storage), 'shim' (no datastore), or 'remote-only'. Runtime state — not authored by hand; read by the shim guards and pbs-job.sh.
placementState.note: Set only on the backup module, at install/update time.
placementState.changeNote: The resolved outcome of that placement, recorded on the deployed config.

pushTarget.description: Backup module, remote-only placement only (ADR-012 P4). Name of the default off-site push target — a config/push-<name>.json describing a REMOTE PBS this cluster pushes its VM backups to when there is no local PBS. Empty/absent means no default; onboard with `backup-manage.sh add-push <name> --make-default`.
pushTarget.note: Set only on the backup module. The push credential is prompted at onboarding, never stored.
pushTarget.changeNote: An off-site datastore this module's backups are pushed to (ADR-010).
